council.subject: council.agent_runtime_truthfulness
council.summary: Do not describe Council role perspectives as physically independent agents unless separate model/runtime processes actually exist; role simulations in one ChatGPT execution context must be labeled honestly.

council.subject: council.desktop_computer_use.contract
council.summary: Full Windows desktop control is a first-class execution capability, not a permanent Council member; prefer application-native automation, then semantic UI Automation, and use physical mouse/keyboard only as fallback with verified before/after state.

council.subject: council.governance.current_structure
council.summary: UniversalCouncil core governance remains v0.3.0; later layered v0.4+ restructuring is a candidate pending measured bake-off and is not yet the governing role structure.

council.subject: council.history.external_self_review_2026_10_07
council.summary: A historical Universal Council external-research self-review proposed evidence-focused protocol upgrades including blind first positions, confidence calibration, evidence matrices, selective debate, consensus-free decisions, decision expiry, premortems, commitment-evidence ladders, foundation-model uplift tests and an anti-bureaucracy budget.

council.subject: council.history.no_winner_arena_2026_10_06
council.summary: A historical RevenueSystem Council 'No-Winner' arena established adversarial self-check patterns: self-attack before criticism, steelman before objection, evidence-backed bias alerts, no vote overriding a documented domain blocker, bounded debate rounds, and no member leaderboard.

council.subject: council.history.specialist_expansion_2026_10_06
council.summary: A historical RevenueSystem Council arena recommended selective expansion with five specialist functions; this records design lineage only and does not override the current UniversalCouncil role configuration.

council.subject: council.history.specialist_methods_2026_10_06
council.summary: The same historical arena deliberately kept several needs as methods/shared functions rather than permanent seats, reinforcing the Council anti-bureaucracy principle.

council.subject: council.hybrid_execution.contract
council.summary: Hybrid execution is now GUI-primary and Desktop Commander secondary. Interactive desktop applications must be operated through GUI first; DC supports filesystem, Git, processes, tests, logs, artifacts and recovery, and may only replace GUI for an interactive app through explicit fallback approval.

council.subject: council.restructure.layered_candidate
council.summary: The preferred restructuring candidate is a layered Council with a Decision Orchestrator, bounded core challenge capabilities, on-demand specialist federation, separate operators and meta-governance; adoption requires bake-off evidence before changing governing role files.

council.subject: memory.fabric.queue_runtime
council.summary: Queue-based Universal Memory autosync is runtime verified after PR #16: writes stage in the gitignored pending queue, sync to GitHub main, and leave the working tree clean after successful delivery.

council.subject: memory.fabric.runtime
council.summary: Universal Memory Fabric completed a real YASSIN-to-GitHub autosync round trip and is runtime verified for append-only event persistence, canonical rebuild, Git-backed preflight, and local FTS retrieval.

council.subject: memory.migration.legacy_artifacts_round2
council.summary: Legacy memory migration round 2 recovered the original Media Venture Council synthesis and all five channel concept decks from the ChatGPT Library and converted their durable strategy into canonical GitHub memory.

council.subject: memory.migration.legacy_artifacts_round3
council.summary: Legacy memory migration round 3 adds durable RevenueSystem owner requirements, a SHA-bounded historical audit baseline, and historical Council specialist-design lineage without promoting dated findings to current truth.

council.subject: memory.migration.legacy_artifacts_round4
council.summary: Legacy memory migration round 4 preserves Council governance-design lineage and dated RevenueSystem strengths without changing current governance or promoting historical source observations to current implementation claims.

council.subject: memory.migration.legacy_chat_round1
council.summary: Legacy memory migration round 1 captures durable YouTube/Media strategy, RevenueSystem requirements, and Council architecture/governance context; exact historical five-channel concepts and detailed prior YouTube policy findings remain intentionally unresolved rather than guessed.

global.subject: memory.fabric.required
global.summary: Use a durable cross-chat and Council memory layer that preserves material changes, retrieves relevant context in future conversations, and synchronizes canonical memory automatically with GitHub.

global.subject: source_of_truth.priority
global.summary: For Council and project work, actual repositories and governing files outrank chat recollection; Universal Memory records durable deltas but does not override repository truth.

project/media.subject: media.pilot.measurement
project/media.summary: No full-scale media operation before a three-video pilot; measure production cost/effort and quality, and if published also measure CTR and audience-retention outcomes before scaling.

project/media.subject: media.production.workflow
project/media.summary: The media venture uses an end-to-end production workflow from market/research and scripting through storyboard/assets, Adobe/AI production, finishing, packaging, QC and performance learning.

project/media.subject: media.production_cell.current
project/media.summary: Media Production Cell v1.8 / media venture v2.1 retain the three-phase serial studio and add a fail-closed W2 script gate. Script & Voice Director owns YouTube-native draft craft, Showrunner clears first-30/anti-article/cold-viewer quality, Motion & Picture Editor reviews script visual beats/drop-off risk, Independent Fact Checker remains separate, and Red Team must resolve timestamped drop-off risks before Script Lock.

project/media.subject: media.specialized_tool_policy.current
project/media.summary: Media production now follows SPECIALIZED TOOL FIRST / CODE LAST FOR CRAFT. Code may orchestrate, validate, automate and QC, but may not substitute for missing professional editing, motion, sound-design, mixing/mastering or finishing tools. Missing craft capability is a CAPABILITY_GAP.

project/media.subject: media.venture.capability
project/media.summary: Media venture uses a venture-scoped production team and requires a 3-video pilot before scale; After Effects motion assembly is runtime verified while full finishing/publishing/analytics remain gated.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.audit.baseline_2026_10_06
project/revenuesystem.summary: Historical source-only audit closure at RevenueSystem SHA 7c6e5d4 remained incomplete and NO-GO for comprehensive closure/remediation planning; it is preserved as a dated audit baseline, not as a claim about current main.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.audit.historical_strengths_2026_10_05
project/revenuesystem.summary: The 2026-10-05 source review recorded several financial/data/security protections worth preserving if still present, but these are historical source observations tied to the reviewed SHA and must be revalidated on current main.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.currency_model
project/revenuesystem.summary: Keep Iraqi coarse cash, Iraqi change and USD separated throughout the application; USD is converted to IQD and summed only in matching/comparison logic where required.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.data_management.contract
project/revenuesystem.summary: RevenueSystem must provide protected data reset plus create/edit/delete management for branches and cashiers, while distinguishing a full reset from deletion of user-entered operational data.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.deployment.contract
project/revenuesystem.summary: A final setup executable is a release deliverable only after required updates are merged and hardening/tests pass; installation/database locations must be explicit and the production machine role must not be inferred from chat history alone.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.import_contract
project/revenuesystem.summary: Imported cashier/branch data must preserve and display point of sale, cashier name, meal/shift and branch; negative spreadsheet values are valid returns and must be handled correctly.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.matching_accounts.contract
project/revenuesystem.summary: Matching is cashier-centric and integrates manual matching, e-payment breakdowns and customer-account transfer; Rafidain and SWITCH bank amounts must remain distributable per cashier for later reconciliation.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.operational_day.rule
project/revenuesystem.summary: Operational days remain open for date differences of 0–2 days; at 3 days or more they become read-only and auto-closure is logged.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.product_identity
project/revenuesystem.summary: The desktop revenue application is named «المطابقة» and exists to replace/streamline the legacy daily revenue workflow.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.recovery_precision.contract
project/revenuesystem.summary: As a financial application, RevenueSystem must prioritize exact financial calculations, preserve signed returns, autosave/recover unsaved work where feasible after sudden closure, and diagnose crash paths without silently losing committed or pending state.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.reporting.contract
project/revenuesystem.summary: RevenueSystem reporting should retain daily-revenue review, add matching-difference and cash/electronic summaries, use portrait layouts by default, and keep branch/cashier reports concise and operationally useful.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.revenue_entry.contract
project/revenuesystem.summary: Cashier revenue entry must support autosave, direct Iraqi-total input, and arithmetic expressions in denomination fields; cash denominations are entered in-app rather than imported from Excel.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.source_of_truth
project/revenuesystem.summary: RevenueSystem execution must use the actual yassenjabal-jpg/RevenueSystem5 repository, current main SHA, governing files, commits/PRs/CI/tests/migrations/artifacts as evidence; chat history is inference only.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.ui_hardening.contract
project/revenuesystem.summary: RevenueSystem UI must minimize wasted title-bar space, prevent overlapping text, show popup fields without unnecessary sidebars/scrolling where feasible, keep window controls top-right, and preserve reliable keyboard navigation.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.visual_redesign.current
project/revenuesystem.summary: Owner directed a real full visual redesign implementation for RevenueSystem: the result must be immediately and visibly different from the current hardened UI, using the approved unified UI design spec rather than treating layout/test hardening as visual redesign.

project/revenuesystem.subject: revenuesystem.visual_redesign.figma_reference
project/revenuesystem.summary: A real editable Figma visual reference was created for the RevenueSystem redesign and bound into the implementation plan; it includes the design system plus Dashboard, Daily Revenue, Reconciliation and Account Statement reference screens.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.adaptation.policy
project/youtube.summary: Use successful US and European channel formats as research benchmarks, but rebuild them for the Arabic market with original scripting, structure and creative execution rather than simple dubbing or minor copying.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.channel.behind_the_system
project/youtube.summary: «العالم خلف الستار» is an evergreen hidden-systems/infrastructure channel explaining how unseen systems move matter, money, energy or data from an everyday action to its result.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.channel.city_2099
project/youtube.summary: «مدينة 2099» is a serialized Arabic sci-fi microdrama/IP bet set in one future city with recurring characters, using Shorts for episodes and long-form compilations for story arcs.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.channel.file_404
project/youtube.summary: «ملف 404» is a digital mystery/internet investigation channel built around checkable evidence, confidence-labelled conclusions and cyber-safety boundaries rather than conspiracy or harmful instructions.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.channel.inside_the_deal
project/youtube.summary: «داخل الصفقة» is the first recommended revenue test: business/money stories showing how companies, products, prices and deals move money inside a narrative rather than a generic finance lesson.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.channel.what_if
project/youtube.summary: «ماذا لو؟» is a speculative documentary channel using fact-grounded alternate history and near-future scenarios, with explicit separation between fact and hypothesis and Arabic retro-futurist visual language.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.channel_operating_system.current
project/youtube.summary: Channel Operating System v1.9 keeps W1 story-first and upgrades W2 into an 11-pass YouTube-native script system. W2 now requires Hook & Retention Map before the first full script, First-30-Second Gate, Anti-Article, Spoken-Language, Visual/Narrative, Open Loop, Cold Viewer, Independent Fact Check and Red Team Retention review before Script Lock. No interval may exceed 90 seconds without a fresh reason to continue; current long-form Script Lock requires at least eight minutes.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.execution.final_prelaunch_decision
project/youtube.summary: Owner rejected «داخل الصفقة» as the channel identity and approved a broad, format-first multilingual visual-documentary channel. «داخل الصفقة» remains only as an internal business-mechanism lane; public/automatic publishing remains unauthorized.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.ideation.review_process
project/youtube.summary: The prior Council ideation process is now artifact-backed: market evidence and adversarial objections reduced many ideas to five differentiated channel concepts, each with its own narrative, visual direction, sample episodes and three-video pilot.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.language_expansion.strategy
project/youtube.summary: Current language architecture is Arabic-first with one language-portable master and one YouTube channel using multi-language audio/localized metadata when available; English is the first localization for proven winners, then Spanish/German/French only when language analytics justify expansion.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.narration_visual_preferences
project/youtube.summary: Default documentary voice and visual direction: warm conversational narration mixing Iraqi Arabic and MSA, medium-slow reflective delivery with light humor, user-recorded voice with emotion tags, and editorial documentary visuals rather than a news-like style.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.operating_rules
project/youtube.summary: The recovered Council strategy treats long-form YouTube as the main revenue/library destination, Shorts as discovery and hook testing, and TikTok/Reels/Facebook as deliberate platform-specific redistribution rather than automatic copy-paste.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.policy_research.status
project/youtube.summary: The historical 2026-10-09 Council artifacts recover the main YouTube policy/monetization findings and anti-AI-slop rules; these are historical evidence and must still be revalidated against current platform policy before operational use.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.portfolio.target
project/youtube.summary: The five-channel portfolio recovered from the Council artifacts is: «ماذا لو؟», «داخل الصفقة», «ملف 404», «العالم خلف الستار», and «مدينة 2099»; it is an idea portfolio, not permission to operate five channels simultaneously.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.strategy.migration
project/youtube.summary: Legacy YouTube strategy migration round 2 recovered the exact five-channel portfolio, ranking, individual concept decks, historical policy findings, anti-slop rules and the first pilot decision from the original Library artifacts.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.title_mining.current
project/youtube.summary: Broad-channel re-study produced an 80-title candidate pool across 10 topic families and selected a three-domain pilot to test whether one editorial/visual identity can bind unrelated subjects.

project/youtube.subject: youtube.visual_system.current
project/youtube.summary: Channel visuals must stay close in visual grammar to the user-supplied reference video: Editorial Renaissance Motion with cobalt/sky-blue fields, paper/ivory space, classical and botanical cutouts, sparse editorial serif typography, illustrated diagrams and object-led transitions.
